owns: domain recovery and trusted-dataset materialization semantics

rules.statement: SourceCheckpoint may enter accepted history only with DatasetCommitted evidence.
Only DatasetValidated can enable StageLoad; ValidationRejected enables QuarantineDataset.
Every accepted transition is appended to the run's one hash-chained journal.
Commands and events identify DataReferences while connectors own bulk transfer.
The selected accepted-history implementation must reject non-contiguous sequence or previous-hash links.
